title: Rabbi Shimon bar Nezira
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.33b.4), in a discussion of a teaching by Rabbi Gurion, or by Rav Yosef bar Shemaya, about a generation that has righteous people. Rabbi Yitzchak bar Zeira, or Rabbi Shimon ben Nezira according to another reading, asks: “What is the verse?” Etc. And in [Yevamot 97a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.97a.1), Rabbi Yochanan said in the name of Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai: Whenever a Torah scholar has a teaching said in his name in this world, his lips (etc.). Rabbi Yitzchak ben Zeira, or Shimon Nezira according to another reading, asks: “What is the verse?” Etc. This statement is also brought in [Shekalim, end of chapter 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.2.5.5): Shimon ben Nezira said in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak: Any Torah scholar etc. And in the [Jerusalem Talmud, Moed Katan chapter 3, end of halakhah 7](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Moed_Katan.3.7.18): Bar Tira said, one who says a teaching in someone's name, his lips move in the grave etc. Hyman proposes without doubt that it should read Bar Nezira, and from nun and zayin a tet was made.

Hyman concludes from this that Bar Nezira is Rabbi Shimon bar Nezira, and under this name we find him in [Shekalim, end of chapter 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shekalim.2.5.5): Bar Nezira says, like someone drinking spiced wine (konditon)…; Rabbi Yitzchak says, like that etc.
And he is likewise mentioned by this name in Song of Songs Rabbah 1:14.

And he is mentioned in [Shabbat, chapter 2, halakhah 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shabbat.2.3.6): Rabbi Acha and Rabbi Simon said in the name of Rabbi Shimon Nezira: If he made it into a bandage, it is ritually pure, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Moed Katan reads Bar Tira. Hyman is certain it should read Bar Nezira and proposes a copying error. Shekalim names Shimon ben Nezira speaking in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name and separately calls the speaker in the spiced-wine comparison Bar Nezira. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3475&lang=en) also cites the Shekalim and Shabbat occurrences.
